top_signals.title: Swift Indian Ban on JPMorgan Unit Seen as Warning to Traders
top_signals.summary: India’s securities regulator issued an interim order against a JPMorgan Chase & Co. unit in record time, a move market watchers say could deter attempts to manipulate the country’s new closing stock auction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
